channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan hands over ‘Qilin’ hacker group member to Germany
item.description: Qilin is believed to have carried out ransomware attacks against companies worldwide, causing major damage through data encryption.

item.title: ‘The Ozu Diaries’: An engaging look at the man behind the myth
item.description: Daniel Raims' "The Ozu Diaries" is a stirringly human portrait of a titan of Japanese film and the experiences that shaped him.

item.title: Suzuki undercuts BYD as competition grows in market for low-budget EV minicars
item.description: The arrival of Suzuki's first fully electric minicar adds to signs Japan is becoming a key battleground for electric versions of the tiny vehicles.

item.title: Western Pacific sees rare trio of storms
item.description: The Japan Weather Association said it was the first time in five years that three systems have existed at the same time in the month of October.

item.title: How to protect yourself against cybersecurity threats
item.description: In light of the influx of recent cyberattacks across Japan, here's what users can do to limit their own vulnerabilities.

item.title: Japan to research use of automatic navigation and AI for SDF transport ships
item.description: The move is expected to support operation of ships by limited numbers of crew, amid a labor shortage reflecting Japan's graying population.

item.title: Japan beats New Zealand in Asian Cup warmup
item.description: Ritsu Doan scored a 71st-minute winner for Japan after New Zealand's Ben Old cancelled out Ayase Ueda's opener in the first half.

item.title: Can Japan build a defense-startup ecosystem?
item.description: Japan needs to build a defense-startup ecosystem that connects government demand, procurement, private capital and civilian dual-use technology.

item.title: Koizumi to meet Okinawa governor after U.S. Marine’s arrest over murder
item.description: Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi said he would like to see new response measures implemented "as soon as possible," but declined to offer a timeline.

item.title: As state funding stalls, medical researchers in Japan pivot to crowdfunding
item.description: Medical campaigns have surged, particularly since the pandemic, when the acute shortage of resources at some hospitals became widely known.

item.title: Nidec scandal sends bonds to bottom in test for new CEO
item.description: The precision motor manufacturer's yen bond due in mid-2032 has slumped to ¥77.7, the lowest among more than 3,000 local corporate notes.

item.title: Finance chiefs of Japan and Australia establish dialogue for economic security
item.description: The two nations will share information on investment trends and discuss supply chains, including those in the defense industry.

item.title: Japan marks 20 years of tackling human error in public transportation
item.description: The transport safety management system requires transport operators to build and continuously improve their own safety management arrangements.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

item.title: Indian opposition MPs detained in protest against election chief
item.description: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.

item.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
item.description: Shoko Kawata's maternity leave drew mixed reactions in Japan, a country struggling to lift birth rates.

item.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
item.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.

item.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
item.description: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.
